description: 台灣中油公司公用天然氣用戶ACH轉帳代繳金融機構一覽表 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣中油股份有限公司. 中油公司天然氣公用事業用戶ACH轉帳代繳金融機構名稱；收集目的：方便民眾迅速查詢可轉帳代繳天然氣費之金融機構，免去繳費時舟車勞頓之苦，及逾期繳費時之不便；該相關資料係由本公司代理出納銀行提供，並不定期更新。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣中油股份有限公司. Its tags are 投資理財. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-05-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
